item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Sia looks at the diagram of an irregular closed shape drawn on $1\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}$ squared paper.

Which claim correctly estimates the area of the shape?

options.A: Read the printed label "squared paper" beside the grid as the area value.
options.B: Count square units covered by the shape, including reasonable fractions of partly covered squares.
options.C: The squared paper is what draws the closed shape, so the grid lines alone are the area.
options.D: Add only the length and breadth of a surrounding rectangle and report that sum as the area.
